verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਫੂਲ ਫੂਲੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਫਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦ੍ਰੂਮ ਲਾਗਤ ਜਿਤੇਕੁ ਪਰਪਕ ਨ ਸਕਲ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jete fool foole tete fal na laage dhraoom laagat jitek parapak na sakal hai ||

en.bdb: All the flowers that blossom on a tree do not yield fruit. And whatever number of fruits appear, do not ripe to be eaten ultimately.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਜਨਮਤ ਜੀਅਤ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਤੇਤੇ ਜੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਕੁਲ ਨ ਕਮਲ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jete sut janamat jeeat rahai na tete jeeat hai jete tete kul na kamal hai ||

en.bdb: All sons born do not survive to live but all those who live do not bring name and fame to their family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਤ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਭੁਟ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਜੇਤਕ ਸੁਭਟ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰਨ ਨ ਥਲ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhal mil jaat jete sabhuT na hoh tete jetak subhaT joojh maran na thal hai ||

en.bdb: All those who join the army are not valiant soldiers. And those who are brave warriors do not die fighting in the battlefield.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਰਸੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਅਚਲ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੮॥
verses.translit_en: aarasee jugat gur sikh sabh hee kahaavai paavak pragaas bhe birale achal hai ||368||

en.bdb: A glass embedded in a finger ring cracks when brought near fire but a genuine stone is unaffected. Similarly like a genuine stone, everyone is known as a Sikh but a few emerge genuine when put through traits. (368)
